text: Li Hongzhi's Zhuan Falun was banned by the Chinese government on 24 July 1996, together with other publications. On 26 July 1999 the Ministry of Public Security called for the confiscation and destruction of all publications related to Falun Gong, and by 30 July Xinhua had reported confiscations of over one million Falun Gong books and other materials.
meta_description: Li Hongzhi's Zhuan Falun was banned in China on 24 July 1996; in July 1999 over one million Falun Gong books were reported confiscated.
changes: Author first; the 1999 call and the Xinhua report merged.
